# Migration status

> **This is the last run against the real incumbent.** At 11:24 UTC on 2026-09-07 the Vercel rewrite
> went live, so `https://www.lodestar-dashboard.com` now *is* this service for every route below.
> Re-running the harness against it from here compares kittiwake with itself and will report perfect
> parity for the wrong reason. To compare against the old handlers, point `--incumbent` at a Vercel
> deployment made before `src/proxy.ts` existed - deployment URLs are permanent - or at a preview
> with `LODESTAR_API_ORIGIN` unset. See #22.

## Per route

Timings are the **median of three warm requests** from wherever this ran, so they include network distance to the incumbent and none to us. They are a comparison, not an absolute. The cold-path figures that motivated the migration are in [benchmarks.md](benchmarks.md); a cold path can only be measured once per cache lifetime and so cannot be sampled here.
